qr.subtitle: Design how this QR code looks. It always opens this address, so printed codes keep working.
qr.unavailable: A QR code is not available for this item.
qr.load_failed: The QR settings could not be loaded.
qr.read_only: You can preview and download this QR code; only account owners and admins can change its design.
qr.preview_unsaved: Server preview, identical to the print (not saved yet)
qr.preview_sketch: Instant sketch; rendering the exact server preview…
qr.preview_invalid: Enter valid colors to see the preview.
qr.preview_server_failed: The server preview failed; showing a local preview.
qr.payload_hint: The QR code encodes this fixed address, never the target. Changing where it points or how it looks never changes the code, so printed copies keep working.
qr.contrast_hint: Use a dark code on a light background with at least {{min}}:1 contrast so every camera can scan it.
qr.contrast_inverted: The code must be darker than the background; light-on-dark codes fail on many scanners.
qr.quiet_zone_hint: The empty margin around the code. Keep at least 4 modules.
qr.logo_pick_media: This profile has no image of that kind. Pick the other image or upload one in the profile first.
qr.logo_hint: Uses a profile photo or cover from this account (PNG/JPEG, up to 2 MB). A logo switches to the highest error correction (H).
qr.download_save_first: Save your changes to download this design.
support.cards_subtitle: Find a card by serial, smart code or card UID across every account.
support.cards_search: Serial, smart code or card UID
support.routes_subtitle: Find a path, see where it points, its history and quarantine.
support.search_hint: Type at least 2 characters to search.
support.retire_desc: Card {{code}} will show "card deactivated" and its path is never handed out again. An unused activation code is cleared. This cannot be undone.
support.reassign_desc: Card {{code}} moves to the profile below, with its account and owner. The printed code and URL stay the same.
support.release_desc: /{{path}} is free right away and a new smart link can take it. Links that are still printed or shared may then reach someone else.
